listing.name: Resident Evil Outbreak — reo (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: First scenario J Bar draws~35x slower than real time; no sound output/card image mount; full scenario untried. File2 only builds. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own NTSC-U SLUS20765 disc files, including SLUS_207.65 and BIN/.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run Setup.cmd to check local prerequisites and build from your own disc. No tagged release is available through this guide. File2 is not an offered player target.
